name: Eco-Connect Community Fund
summary: Small grants of up to AUD 2,000 per group per year for community-led environmental work in the Northern Territory, including native planting and restoration, weed control and caring for local natural areas.

amount.note: Per group per year; groups may submit several applications up to the annual cap.

steps: Submit online or request a paper application form

status.quote: Applications are open year-round Applications are assessed monthly

applicant_types.quote: Community or volunteer groups Indigenous groups and organisations Ranger groups Not-for-profit organisations Schools

geography.quote: support small-scale, community-led environmental projects, activities and capacity-building initiatives across the Northern Territory

access.quote: Submit your application online at any time while funding is available.

window.quote: Applications are open year-round Applications are assessed monthly

amount.quote: Funding available: Up to $2,000 per group, per year

effort.quote: Submit your application online at any time while funding is available.
If a paper application form is required, please request one here:

eligibility.quote: Applicants must hold public liability insurance for any activities they plan to undertake using Eco-Connect Community Funds.
All previously approved funding applications must be acquitted before applying again.

Funding cannot be used for: Insurance costs Wages or payments to group members Power tools, non-native plants or capital items IT equipment (computers, mobile phones, tablets) or IT software Activities outside the Northern Territory Items purchased prior to applying for funding

after_award.quote: Successful applicants will submit a Funding Activity & Acquittal Report form within 30 days after completion of approved funding activities

eligibility.rule: Holds public liability insurance for the funded activities
All earlier Eco-Connect grants acquitted before applying again
Request grant funding only for costs and activities permitted under the Eco-Connect guidelines.
